reason: I've already got a collagen in the cupboard that I take without thinking, so I'm not going to order another one this week. It does make me want to check whether mine is halal, and if it isn't I might switch when it runs out.
objection: An unflavoured powder I have to remember to scoop into my tea every day sounds like a chore, and I don't know who certified it halal or if it actually does anything my current one doesn't.
would_change_my_mind: Finding out my current collagen isn't halal, and seeing a recognised UK halal certifier named on the pack.
